title: The Dock Is Full
summary: On Day nine, locked in a boathouse with a sick boy, Nora sees what is waiting on the dock.

beats.text: Day nine. Alder had locked us in with a sick boy. Ava pounded on the door.
Jonah slept on the cot, hot. The scratch was thin and clean.
"That's not a bite," Ava whispered. "Bites have teeth."
beats.speaker: ava

beats.text: Alder spoke through the wood. "I locked it for the water."
Through the slats I saw heads rise from the lake.
They climbed onto the dock and stood in a dripping row.
Alder lifted a floorboard. Under it, black water and a canoe.
We slid out under the dock in silence, Jonah between us.
Every head on the dock turned together, toward the canoe.
Then my phone buzzed. One bar, and a message from Grace.
lines: Nora, I am on the lake road. Almost there.
